content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to use a PT100 sensor to measure temperatures from 0 to 550°C. I am aware that the [product_name] expansion module does not support this range. Is it possible to connect the PT100 sensor directly to an analog input of the [product_name] controller, using an appropriate resistor in series?

No, that's not feasible. The measurement range of the [product_name] expansion module is fixed at -50 to 200°C. While you can connect a PT100 sensor directly with a resistor, the measurement accuracy will be poor and the error will be significant. Instead, you should use an external PT100 transmitter designed for your required temperature range with an output signal of 0-10V or 0/4-20mA.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges when attempting to measure temperatures that exceed the supported range of the [product_name] module using a PT100 sensor. Direct connection with a resistor to an analog input results in substantial measurement errors, highlighting the necessity of using compatible transmitters for accurate sensor integration across a wider temperature range.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to extend the temperature measurement range of their [product_name] system up to 550°C using a PT100 sensor, ideally through a straightforward hardware solution such as a resistor.
